sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the globe
sections.what: Brings in the React hooks and the globe drawing library.
sections.why: Lets the component draw the globe and manage its lifetime on the page.
sections.watch_out: The globe depends on an outside library, so an update to that library could change how the globe looks.

sections.name: GlobeHero (part 1)
sections.title: Globe setup and resize handling
sections.what: Creates the globe on the canvas, with India as the marked location, and sets its colours, lighting and marker size. It also redraws the globe when the window changes size.
sections.why: Sets up the globe to match the look of the site and keeps it sharp at any window size.
sections.watch_out: The map sample count is large, so the first draw may take a noticeable moment on a slow device.

sections.name: GlobeHero (part 2)
sections.title: Rotation and pulsing animation
sections.what: Turns the globe a small amount on every frame and changes the India halo size with a slow pulse. When the component leaves the screen, it stops the animation, removes the listener and destroys the globe.
sections.why: Keeps the globe moving and draws attention to India, and the cleanup prevents leaks when the user moves on.
sections.watch_out: Cleanup must stay in place. Without it, the animation keeps running after the page changes.

summary: A slowly rotating 3D globe that marks India with a pulsing dot, used as decoration on the page.
purpose: Adds a visual hero element that shows where the service is focused.
why: Likely reason: a decorative globe makes the first screen feel engaging. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Starts a globe drawing on a canvas with India marked. On each animation frame it turns the globe a little and changes the halo size with a sine wave. It redraws the globe when the window size changes. When the component leaves the screen, it stops the animation, removes the resize listener, and destroys the globe.
inputs: The canvas element size from the page. No props.
outputs: A decorative, hidden-from-screen-reader globe in a wrapper element.
risks: The animation redraws on every frame, which uses processor time on slow devices. Forgetting the cleanup would leave animations or listeners running after the page changes.
debug: If the globe is blank, check that the canvas has a size and that the globe library loads. If the page feels slow, check the frame loop and the number of map samples.
